title: Lazy Sunday Norwegian Fritters
description: A simple and delicious breakfast or brunch option, these Norwegian fritters are made with rolled oats, eggs, and cheese. Perfect for a lazy Sunday morning.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together oats, eggs, milk, and flour.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add a small amount of oil to the pan and pour in the oat mixture.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bottom is golden brown.
Flip the fritters and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve hot with cheese and enjoy!
